newsitem.title: CANADA: Newbridge equipment part of Brazil order.
newsitem.headline: Newbridge equipment part of Brazil order.

text.p: Newbridge Networks Corp said on Tuesday that Equitel, the Siemens AG distributor to Brazilian telephone companies, won a US$22 million order from Telecomunicacoes de Rio de Janeiro S.A. (TELERJ), the state-owned telephone company.
The deal is for the supply of equipment and serdvices for a data network for the state of Rio de Janeiro. This contract is the first awarded to Equitel for Newbridge equipment, Newbridge said.

Equitel's contract includes Newbridge advanced networking products comprising 3600 and 3645 MainStreet Bandwidth Managers and Frame Relay Switch multi-port cards to provide frame relay capability on the 3600 and 3645 MainStreet switches. Network management will be supplied by the MainStreetXpress 46020 Network Manager system.

Installation of the data network will begin by April and be finished by the end of the year. The network will add 8,500 access data nodes in 115 TELERJ central offices and in high-end corporate environments throughout the state including the capital of Rio de Janeiro, Newbridge said.
